review_description: Hounded me to pay final invoice, even though they stated it didn't need to be finalised until 2 weeks prior to delivery.No answer when asking on its progress from the number questioning the invoice.Was told it was ready and would be delivered this week. The week after I was still trying to determine if it was actually ready and when delivery might be.Was told i would be contacted in regards to this.No call came through.
Quoting was to the point and took in my needs and ideas.Installation was quick and well-organized independent inspector was impressed by quality of work.

We had originally signed up with a 'recommended' solar provider (through SolarQuotes), who after 3 months still couldn't give us an installation date.Fed up, I spoke to Sky Energy two days before Christmas. Craig was fantastic - turned around a quote incredibly quickly, explained what we needed to do, managed our expectations on timings and clearly articulated next steps and requirements. Cost was pretty much on par with the other group we'd originally signed for - not the cheapest, but not the most expensive. A fair blend combined with great service.We got an installation date confirmed in between Christmas and New Years, and had some interactions with the wider team through January - every single interaction was with a friendly, helpful and supportive team member.The team who came to install were clear on what we needed, turned up on time, were able to get the job done with a minimum of fuss. Timings were super quick - 6 weeks to install (despite the Christmas/New Years break, and some interesting weather), and about a week or so to connection.From our experience, things you'll want to look out for:- people who are willing and wanting to work with you- happy to explain any questions you have- keep to their word- keep you informed- instill trust that they can deliver what you need, when you need it.These guys were able to do this for us. Really happy with the support from the team, and Craig thanks so much for making this happen!note: In regards to working with SolarQuotes. While our choice of working with Sky Energy wasn't sourced via SolarQuotes, after I reached out to their team for help on what to do given the shoddy experience we were getting from one of their recommended providers, the SolarQuotes team were brilliant. Quick to respond, provided three companies to chat to, escalated our issue. Ultimately we found a better solution through Sky Energy, but I did appreciate SolarQuote's support.
